t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

d: A suffragette invited to Wichita to give a speech is interrupted by men supporting Senator Teague who is against women voting.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

d: Earp learns Masterson has dropped out of school and is a scout for the Army.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Taylors open a café in Wichita but word that he is a cousin of criminal Mannon Clements causes strife for them.

d: The Big T outfit is angry with Earp's attempt to tame Dodge City so they decide to ambush him with the help of Jim Kelley.

d: Pete Albright tries to hire gunfighter Clay Allison to kill Earp to open up Dodge City. Allison won't take money but is willing to kill Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: The Judge's daughter has fallen for Earp but Earp realizes there is no future for them given his job.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Dora is forcing Kelly to sell his saloon so Albright and McGuire see an opportunity to not only buy it but to get rid of Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Bat returns to Dodge City on the stage with the lovely Nellie Wright hoping to earn a star. He quickly ends up in a gunfight and learns Nellie is part of an outlaw gang but she wants out.

d: New deputy Bat Masterson mistakenly shoots a drunk with an empty gun in the back to protect Hal.

d: The George Morris gang tries to take over Dodge City while Earp and Sheriff Bassett are gone. They succeed but Bat escapes capture to catch Earp.

d: Earp is not happy with Judge Tobin's habit of being liberal with sentencing men to hang.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Two Cheyennes have been killed, which can start a new Indian war. The Cheyenne chief plans to attack Dodge City for revenge.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Mrs. McGill resorts to guns to save their water and pasture for Hap Dorsett who she hopes will marry her daughter.

d: Earp is involved in the backlash from Custer's last battle when crooked Indian agents come to Dodge City to blame the army and Capt. Benteen for the loss.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
d: Earp arrests a drunk Sgt. Craig for killing an Indian in a Dodge City store. However, the Captain at Fort Dodge has other ideas about whether it is a crime for a soldier to kill an Indian.

d: Ben Thompson returns as a dealer at a saloon outside Dodge City. When he is caught cheating, he engages in a gunfight with several hands from the Circle Bar ranch.
